description: A video generation tool that allows users to add voice-overs to videos, offering various voice options for diverse applications. Vadoo AI is the all-in-one AI video generator built for short-form content. Create TikToks, Reels, Shorts, and podcasts with AI scriptwriting, text-to-video, captions, voiceovers, B-roll, SEO tools, and auto-posting — all in one platform.
